title: Lotofácil 3758: accumulated prize of R$5 million attracts bettors
seoTitle: Lotofácil 3758: R$5 million prize draws bettors
subtitle: R$5 million prize and various betting modes spark interest
excerpt: After contest 3757, the prize rolled over to R$5 million, raising expectations for Lotofácil 3758, drawn Monday at 9 PM, with multiple betting options.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Lotofácil contest 3757 had no winner with 15 numbers, causing the prize to roll over to R$5 million. This amount has raised great expectations for the next draw, 3758, which will take place on Monday.

Next Lotofácil draw (3758)

Draw 3758 is scheduled for Monday, August 10, at 9 PM, according to the Caixa Econômica Federal calendar. The estimated prize is R$5 million, a sum that already attracts thousands of bettors across the country.

Result of contest 3757

The drawn numbers were 15, 08, 20, 24, 02, 04, 11, 06, 12, 23, 22, 03, 17, 01 and 21. No bettor matched all 15 numbers, so the prize rolled over. There were 178 bets with 14 matches, each receiving R$2,380.88; 6,676 bets with 13 matches, each receiving R$35; 89,570 bets with 12 matches, each receiving R$14; and 522,035 bets with 11 matches, each receiving R$7.

How the prize works

The gross prize corresponds to 43.79 % of the draw’s revenue. Among winners, 72 % of the prize pool goes to those who hit all 15 numbers, 13 % to those who hit 14 numbers, and the remainder can be rolled over for special contests. In zero‑ending contests, a larger share is allocated to the 15‑match winners, with 72 % for them and 13 % for the 14‑match winners.

Betting options and costs

Players can select between 15 and 20 numbers out of the 25 available on the ticket. There is also the “Surpresinha”, where the numbers are automatically generated by Caixa, and the “Teimosinha”, which allows repeating the same bet in 3, 6, 12, 18 or 24 consecutive draws. The bet price varies with the number of selections: R$7 for 11 numbers, R$14 for 12 numbers and R$35 for 13 numbers.

Draw frequency

Lotofácil holds six draws per week: Monday through Friday, always at 9 PM, and on Sundays at 11 AM. This regularity ensures bettors have numerous opportunities to compete for the accumulated prize.

With information from Estadão, G1.
